headline: Soybean Prices Hit Near Three-Month Low on International Market
summary: Soybeans dropped to their lowest price in nearly three months on the international market, closing at $438.44 per ton on the Chicago Board of Trade.
why: Soybeans are a primary global agricultural commodity and a crucial export earner for major Latin American economies, impacting trade balances and agricultural sector revenues.

impacts.name: Soybean futures
impacts.why: Prices dropped to a three-month low on the Chicago Board of Trade.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Persistent downward pressure over multiple trading sessions drove futures down to a three-month low, raising economic alert levels for exporting nations.
